headline: [Weekly Stock Outlook] KOSPI Index Tests Recovery Above 7,000 – "Recovery Phase Reflecting Earnings"
summary: The KOSPI index climbed to just below the 7,000 level this week. The gain was driven by a rebound in large semiconductor stocks and foreign spot buying.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's benchmark stock index, heavily weighted toward large chipmakers such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
